To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IIT Guwahati Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Technical Staff: Any graduate with 3 years of relevant experience in field and Laboratory. Research Associate: B.Tech and M.Tech in Civil Engineering, and PhD in relevant field from reputed national institute with 1 year experience in large scale hydrological projects.

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Technical Staff: Rs. 35000 + 20% HRA Per Month Research Associate: Rs. 80000 + 20% HRA Per Month

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Guwahati Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati Project Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the IIT Guwahati Project Staff recruitment is 17-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Staff at IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for Project Staff posts at IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Online.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Staff positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 35000 to Rs. 80000 per month, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Technical Staff post?
faq.answer: For the Technical Staff post, any graduate with 3 years of relevant experience in field and Laboratory is required.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: For the Research Associate post, candidates need B.Tech and M.Tech in Civil Engineering, and PhD in a relevant field with 1 year of experience in large scale hydrological projects.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for IIT Guwahati Project Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for IIT Guwahati recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the Important Links section of this article, or by visiting the official IIT Guwahati website.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these Project Staff positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these Project Staff positions is Contractual.
